mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM supplier
AND supplier_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{supplierName}, '%')
AND phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{phone}, '%')
AND status = #{status}
SELECT FROM supplier WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY supplier_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO supplier (supplier_id, supplier_name, contact_person, phone, address, status) VALUES (#{supplierId}, #{supplierName}, #{contactPerson}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE supplier SET supplier_name = #{supplierName}, contact_person = #{contactPerson}, phone = #{phone}, address = #{address}, status = #{status} WHERE supplier_id = #{supplierId}
